description: This Java class implements a custom service discovery mechanism for Docker swarm clusters using Akka. It resolves service hostnames to IP addresses without caching DNS entries, facilitating bootstrapping in dynamic Docker swarm environments.

classes.name: DockerSwarmServiceDiscovery
classes.description: A service discovery implementation for Docker swarm clusters that resolves DNS entries without caching, aiding in cluster bootstrapping.

classes.name: Resolved
classes.description: A data structure representing the result of a service resolution, including service name and resolved targets.

methods.name: DockerSwarmServiceDiscovery
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service discovery with an actor system.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous lookup for a service, resolving its hostname to IP addresses within a specified timeout.

methods.name: resolveService
methods.description: Resolves the hostname of a service to a list of resolved targets using Java InetAddress API.

methods.name: scheduleTimeout
methods.description: Schedules a timeout for the service lookup operation, failing if resolution does not complete within the given duration.
